diagnosis.source: GitHub Actions job step timings and job log read with gh api
confirmed: Step 'Execute bounded Taiwan chip refresh' started 09:21:12Z and failed 09:56:25Z with: The action ... has timed out after 35 minutes.

The last log lines before the timeout are the fifth profile (tw-taifex-put-call, preflight passed 09:55:40Z) at ' Container pantheon-source-ingest-1  Recreate' (09:56:14Z), i.e. the cut came inside the Compose recreate of source-ingest.

The log has a 'restoring steady collector-host egress posture' line after each of profiles 1-4 (09:29:10Z, 09:38:40Z, 09:48:03Z, 09:54:02Z) and none after 09:56:14Z: the remote restore never ran for profile 5.

scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh installed restore_bounded_source_refresh on EXIT and handle_bounded_refresh_signal only on INT and TERM; HUP and PIPE had no handler, so a dropped SSH session (HUP, or SIGPIPE on the next write to the dead pipe) terminated the remote shell without a restore.

A killed Compose recreate leaves a Created rename leftover (reported by the operator as 62f4371e62ff_pantheon-source-ingest-1) that later made Root run 44295978076 fail at capture with 'expected exactly one Compose container'.
diagnosis.not_observable_by_a_worker: Workers have no SSH to hosted; the HUP versus PIPE choice and the 09:56-12:40Z outage window come from the operator report, not from the log. Both signals are handled, so the fix does not depend on which one arrived.

measured_per_profile_minutes.components: 51-67s steady lease wait, two bounded one-shot containers up to SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=300 each, two source-ingest recreates with /readyz waits, restore
measured_per_profile_minutes.conclusion: 35 minutes fit only four profiles. Step budget is now 6 x 15 = 90 minutes, each profile is also wrapped in timeout --kill-after=60 900 so a timeout stops at a profile boundary, and the job limit is 150 minutes.

scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh: HUP (129) and PIPE (141) now run the same restore as INT and TERM; for HUP and PIPE the restore ignores further HUP/PIPE and logs to PANTHEON_BOUNDED_REFRESH_RESTORE_LOG (default /tmp/pantheon-bounded-refresh-restore.log) so a dead SSH pipe cannot kill it.

remove_source_ingest_compose_leftovers removes only containers with status=created for the source-ingest family services (project pantheon), logging each id; it runs before and after the steady restore. Running and exited containers are never removed.
verify_source_ingest_container_counts fails the restore (reason source_ingest_container_count) when any family service has more than one container.

New --refresh-only --steady-check mode (execute_steady_posture_check): one SSH call; verifies source-ingest and source-ingest-scheduler are running, healthy, scheduler in collector_steady_pull, no bounded or created leftovers; waits up to 90s for an in-flight restore; otherwise runs the existing manage_source_ingest_refresh_runtime restore and starts the stopped scheduler/projector; writes {mode, reason, status} with status healthy, restored or failed.
New step 'Verify and restore steady source-ingest posture' with if: always() && lease succeeded, so it runs after failure, timeout and cancellation; it merges steady_restore_check {status, reason} into tw-refresh-outcome.json and fails the run with ::error::steady_restore_check_<status>: <reason> unless healthy.
Upload step now always runs after the lease (was skipped when the refresh step was cancelled) and also uploads steady-restore-check.json; lease release additionally requires the check to succeed.
Chip step timeout 35 -> 90 minutes with a 15 minute per-profile bound; job timeout 60 -> 150 minutes.

scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py: test_interrupted_bounded_refresh_restores_steady_services_for_real[HUP|TERM|PIPE]: runs the real entrypoint against a stateful fake docker, interrupts it mid-recreate, asserts restore ran, steady containers started, bounded containers removed, Created leftover removed by id, steady containers never removed
scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh_workf: test_steady_check_step_* : runs the real step script from the workflow YAML in a job checkout layout with a fake lease wrapper and fake deploy script for healthy, restored and transport-failure outcomes
tests.result: scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh_workflow.py 24 passed; scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py 167 passed, 14 failed, all 14 are finmind tests failing on ModuleNotFoundError: pydantic in this worker environment (unrelated to this change).

limits: The steady check requires the scheduler to be in collector_steady_pull as the task specifies; a host intentionally steady in reconcile_only would be reported restored/failed.

The check's restore reuses the env of the existing source-ingest container minus the bounded-only keys; non-controlled bounded keys such as SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS would carry over if source-ingest was left in the bounded environment.
A worker cannot run the real hosted path; the first scheduled run's steady_restore_check field in the tw-refresh-outcome artifact is the live acceptance probe.
runtime_budget: No new job or persistent writer; one extra SSH call per run and one steady_restore_check field in the existing outcome artifact.
